Overview

Pucallpa is a city in UC with a population of 250,000. A rapidly growing Amazonian city on the Ucayali River, a gateway to Peru’s jungle region. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
